title: CardRevised
description: Payload: a card changed rank, identity, band, lens or rationale. Never silent (INV-21): it carries what it was, what it is, the exact fields that differ, and the events that changed it. Ledger rules: 'previous' is the card's current state, 'diff' is exactly the fields in which previous and card differ, and every reasonEventSeqs entry is an earlier event.

reasonEventSeqs.description: Ledger positions of the events that changed it.

diff.description: The fields that differ, at least one.
